findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Outgoing network and URL requests
 * @description Check usage of requests and urllib for potential SSRF or local file inclusion via file:// URLs
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/ssrf-url-resolution
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "head", "request", "Session"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "Request", "urlretrieve"]).getACall()
select call, "URL request at " + call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() + ":" + call.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Check if jsonschema resolves remote or file:// URLs via requests or urllib.request (e.g. in RefResolver or referencing handlers), potentially leading to SSRF.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect HTTP/URL resolution context in validators.py
 * @description Examine functions and arguments used in URL resolution within jsonschema/validators.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/inspect-ssrf-validators
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Function f
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "request", "post", "head"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "Request"]).getACall()
  ) and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "validators.py" and
  f = call.getScope()
select call, "In function '" + f.getName() + "' (lines " + f.getLocation().getStartLine().toString() + "-" + f.getLocation().getEndLine().toString() + "), call to " + call.asExpr().toString() + " with arg0=" + call.getArg(0).asExpr().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Inspect how RefResolver or validator classes resolve external URLs via requests.get and urllib.request.urlopen, checking for SSRF or local file inclusion via file:// URIs

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Callers and references to remote retrieval functions
 * @description Find all uses of _warn_for_remote_retrieve and resolve_remote to check if SSRF/local file read via file:// URI is reachable by default
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/ssrf-callers
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python

from AstNode n
where
  (
    n.(Name).getId() in ["_warn_for_remote_retrieve", "resolve_remote", "RefResolver", "_REMOTE_WARNING"] or
    n.(Attribute).getAttr() in ["_warn_for_remote_retrieve", "resolve_remote"]
  ) and
  n.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() != "noxfile.py"
select n, "Reference to " + n.toString() + " in " + n.getScope().toString() + " at line " + n.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Check how _warn_for_remote_retrieve and RefResolver.resolve_remote are wired into default validation and registry configuration, and whether urllib.request.urlopen allows file:// or http:// SSRF by default.
